title: A-Maze-Ox oxygen-target derivation and internal-consistency audit

target_derivation_basis_as_described_by_.blood_gases_and_pH: Article Table 1 cites reference 35 for UA/UV pO2, sO2, pCO2 and pH.
target_derivation_basis_as_described_by_.hemoglobin_and_hematocrit: GA-specific Hb/Hct values cited to reference 41.
target_derivation_basis_as_described_by_.calculation_equations: O2 and CO2 transfer computed with equations cited to Khadka et al., reference 42 (Table 1 footnote c).
target_derivation_basis_as_described_by_.flow_for_transfer_rates: OTR/CTR calculated from transfer per blood volume and GA-dependent mean UV flow cited to reference 22 (Table 1 footnote d).
target_derivation_basis_as_described_by_.source_locator: Materials and methods > Physiological requirements > Blood-gas values; Table 1 and its footnotes.
target_derivation_basis_as_described_by_.independent_recalculation: not performed; the article references were preserved but their underlying source files/equations were not locally pinned.

arithmetic_check.interpretation: The table OT values multiplied by the listed UV flows round to the printed table OTR values. Using the Results/Discussion OT values yields slightly different rates. The article does not explain the small OT target discrepancy; both remain source-reported and unresolved.

comparison_implication.classification: The measured maximum is below both versions of both targets; the source disagreement does not change that qualitative comparison.

article_test_limit: The oxygen-transfer measurements came from one in-vitro proof-of-concept test using abattoir porcine blood and ISO 7199 conditioning; the authors say no statistical analysis was performed.
